fullPassage: A remarkable characteristic of the visual system is that it has the ability of adapting itself. Psychologist George M. Stratton made this clear in an impressive self-experiment. Stratton wore reversing glasses for several days, which literally turned the world upside down for him. In the beginning, this caused him great difficulties: just putting food in his mouth with a fork was a challenge for him. With time, however, his visual system adjusted to the new stimuli from reality, and he was able to act normally in his environment again, even seeing it upright when he concentrated. As he took off his reversing glasses, he was again confronted with problems: he used the wrong hand when he wanted to reach for something, for example. Fortunately, Stratton could reverse the perception, and he did not have to wear reversing glasses for the rest of his life. For him, everything returned to normal after one day.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

✅ ④ reverse: could reverse (조동사 could + 동사원형) — 적절.
det.tip: be confronted with ~: ~에 직면하다(수동태). was + 과거분사(confronted)

det.analysis:

✅ ③ turned: 'which turned the world' — 계속적 관계대명사절의 과거 동사로 적절.

✅ ④ adjusted: 'his visual system adjusted' — 과거 동사로 적절.
det.tip: make + 목적어 + 형용사(보어): made this clear (이것을 분명하게 만들다). 보어는 부사가 아닌 형용사.

✅ ② made: made this clear (과거 동사) — 적절.

✅ ③ took: 'As he took off' — 부사절의 과거 동사로 적절.

✅ ④ wear: 'did not have to wear' — have to 뒤 동사원형으로 적절.
det.tip: 명사절(that + 주어 + 동사)에는 반드시 본동사 필요. it has the ability.

det.korean: ③ repeat(반복하다) → reverse(되돌리다)
det.analysis:
✅ ① literally: 세상이 '말 그대로' 뒤집혔다 — 적절.

✅ ② upright: 집중하면 '똑바로' 보였다 — 적절.

❌ ③ repeat(반복하다) → reverse(되돌리다): 뒤집혔던 인식을 '되돌려서' 안경을 계속 쓸 필요가 없었다는 맥락이므로 repeat는 부적절. ←정답

questions.passage: A remarkable characteristic of the visual system is that it has the ability of adapting itself. Psychologist George M. Stratton made <u>this</u> clear in an impressive self-experiment. Stratton wore reversing glasses for several days, which literally turned the world upside down for him. In the beginning, this caused him great difficulties: just putting food in his mouth with a fork was a challenge for him. With time, however, his visual system adjusted to the new stimuli from reality, and he was able to act normally in his environment again, even seeing it upright when he concentrated. As he took off his reversing glasses, he was again confronted with problems: he used the wrong hand when he wanted to reach for something, for example. Fortunately, Stratton could reverse the perception, and he did not have to wear reversing glasses for the rest of his life. For him, everything returned to normal after one day.
questions.stem:

"Psychologist George M. Stratton made this clear in an impressive self-experiment."

❌ ① 스트래튼이 심리학자가 된 이유: 본문에 없음
❌ ③ 역전 안경이 위험하다는 경고: 위험 경고가 아님
❌ ④ 포크로 음식을 먹는 방법: 뒤에 나오는 세부 예시일 뿐
det.tip: made this clear: this = 앞 문장의 핵심 주장(시각 체계의 적응 능력)
